rationale: The original thesis relied on the 5-minute 9-EMA acting as dynamic resistance to push price through the $80.62 session low, but price has failed to make new lows over the past 20 minutes and is now grinding higher above the 9-EMA ($80.74) at $80.83. With the sequence of higher lows on the 1-minute bars and the broader market bouncing slightly from its lows (SPY improving from -2.17% to -2.04%), the immediate downward momentum has stalled, warranting an exit ahead of the $80.95 hard stop.
